evidence.section: 3.3.3. Effect of Sc element and microstructure refinement on room temperature fracture toughness
evidence.quote: After heat treatment, the microstructure of NSZ-Sc(HT) alloy is refined and the number of phase boundary is increased, which leads to the dislocations cannot slip smoothly during the deformation process, so the room temperature fracture toughness is increased greatly.

Except for Nb-16Si-20Zr and Nb-16Si-20Zr-2C, the room temperature fracture toughness of other Nb-Si-Zr based alloys is improved after heat treatment, which is related to the tetragonal crystal structure of α Nb5Si3 phase and the spheroidization of the phase.
